build.buildCommand: yarn install && yarn workspace @nidal-alrouh/backend prisma generate && yarn workspace @nidal-alrouh/backend build && sed -i '/apps\/frontend/d' package.json && find node_modules -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -not -name '.cache' -exec rm -rf {} + && yarn install --production --ignore-scripts --prefer-offline

deploy.startCommand: yarn workspace @nidal-alrouh/backend prisma migrate deploy && yarn workspace @nidal-alrouh/backend start
